name: P(the car ahead deploys in this zone)
target: rival_dep: the car ahead drew >= 0.12 MJ in this zone (ESTIMATED)

feature_definitions.rival_soc: car ahead's ESTIMATED SOC at zone entry, MJ; NaN -> 2.5
feature_definitions.rival_deploys_earlier: count of zones this lap where the car ahead already deployed
feature_definitions.rival_prev_zone: 1 if the car ahead deployed at the previous zone of this lap; NaN -> 0.5
feature_definitions.rival_gap_ahead_of_them: the car ahead's own gap to the car in front of it, s, capped 5; NaN -> 5
feature_definitions.gap: our gap to them at zone entry, s
feature_definitions.tyre_delta: our tyre age minus theirs, laps
feature_definitions.zone_idx: index of the zone within the lap, 0-based

preprocessing: none: raw units, NaN fills as stated
output: probability the car ahead covers; used as c in the policy EV
